Alameda, Palo Alto, Santa Clara, and Healdsburg have municipal electricity services; use their city entries. PG&E residential customer service is 877-660-6789. Names such as Ava Community Energy, MCE, WestLight Energy (formerly Peninsula Clean Energy), San José Clean Energy, Silicon Valley Clean Energy, Sonoma Clean Power, or CleanPowerSF usually identify generation plans. PG&E 说明一般不能直接把账户换成另一人的名字：通常是旧持有人停用、新持有人以: PG&E says an account generally cannot simply be renamed to another person. Usually the old holder stops service and the new holder starts an account, coordinating effective dates; exceptions follow the official process.
Castro Valley、San Lorenzo、Alamo、Kensingt: Communities such as Castro Valley, San Lorenzo, Alamo, Kensington, El Sobrante, North Fair Oaks, and Marin City are not counted among the 101 incorporated municipalities above. A postal city name does not prove that the property is inside that city’s service area. Ask the landlord or manager which providers currently bill the property, then check the county, water district, and waste franchise boundaries rather than using the nearest city’s contacts. Private wells, septic systems, special campuses, and commercial properties may follow different arrangements.
